summary: The ChangeReminder module handles the user workflow for changing the security or reminder question used in password recovery. It allows users to select or enter a new reminder question, validate their answer, and confirm their current password. The workflow includes form validation, input handling, and appropriate error/warning display. System behavior ensures secure update of reminder questions and answers.
purpose: To provide users with a secure process for changing their forgotten password reminder question and answer, ensuring authentic validation via current password and enforcing input requirements for security.

fields.name: ddReminderQuestion
fields.description: Dropdown for selecting predefined reminder questions.

fields.name: txtReminderQuestion
fields.description: Textbox for entering custom reminder question.

fields.name: txtAnswer
fields.description: Textbox for entering the answer to the reminder question.

fields.name: txtCurrentPassword
fields.description: Textbox for entering user’s current password.

workflows.name: Change Reminder Question
steps: User navigates to the ChangeReminder page.
System displays current reminder question and answer fields.
User chooses either to select a predefined question (dropdown) or enter a custom question (textbox).
User enters the answer for the new reminder question.
User enters current password for authentication.
System validates: current password is not empty; chosen reminder question is valid; answer is at least 4 characters.
If validation succeeds, System calls Security.ChangeReminder to update the question and answer.
System displays success message and redirects user.
If validation fails, System displays appropriate errors in error panel.

business_rules: Reminder question entered by user must be at least 10 characters.
If using dropdown, user must select a question (not default blank).
Answer to reminder question must be at least 4 characters.
Current password field must not be empty.
Validation occurs on client and server side.
conditions: If ddReminderQuestion.Visible is true, user must select from dropdown.
If txtReminderQuestion.Visible is true, user must enter custom question with at least 10 characters.
system_behavior: Displays errors in panel when validation fails.
Hides/shows controls depending on user choice.
Focuses correct control after page render.
Registers JavaScript variables and handles async postbacks.
On successful change, redirects to Tools.aspx.
Processes error and warning messages through dedicated panels.
exceptions: Form submission with invalid fields blocks update and displays error messages.
If change fails at Security.ChangeReminder, no update occurs and user is informed.
content_gaps: No information on backend error handling or logging.
No explicit localization details for resource messages.
No details on how dsReminderQuestion source retrieves questions.
